The optional tutorial for new characters, played in a cave of crystals and lava beneath {wiki:Dawnport|Dawnport}. You learn to walk, pick up items, attack, loot, eat and talk to NPCs, and at the end you are teleported to Dawnport with a {item:Backpack}, a {item:Rope}, a {item:Torch} and 3 {item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins}.
New character: when you create the character you have to tick the box *"Do you want to play the tutorial?"*.
During the tutorial there is almost no connection to the server: you do not see other players or chat messages, and actions are limited. This is normal.

There is no path to this cave (underneath Dawnport): you appear there automatically the first time you log in with the new character, if you ticked the tutorial box. When the client finishes loading, you appear in a cave surrounded by crystals and lava. Click the highlighted square to walk there.
Pick up the {item:Dagger} from the floor and put it in your {wiki:Inventory|inventory}.
Click the {creature:Wounded Cave Draptor} that appeared to attack it. When it dies, loot the corpse.
The start of the tutorial in the crystal cave (1)
The start of the tutorial in the crystal cave (2)
Talk to {npc:Menesto}. He keeps his dagger and gives you a piece of {item:Meat}.
Eat the {item:Meat}. Then click the highlighted keyword in the NPC channel.
With the {item:Rope}, use the ladder to the **west**, climb up through the hole using the rope and step into the {item:Crystal Teleporter}.
On the way to the Crystal Teleporter (1)
On the way to the Crystal Teleporter (2)

The loading screen appears again and your character is teleported to a small cave right under the {wiki:Adventurer's Outpost|Adventurer's Outpost}, in {wiki:Dawnport|Dawnport}. From here you are fully connected to the server and can interact with other players.

This tutorial started out as exclusive to the {wiki:Flash Client|Flash Client} (you played it when logging in for the first time with the account's first character). It later moved to Tibia 11 and today it can be played by any new character.
